commentary.text: 90+7' Jose Guzman is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Girona couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
90+4' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
90+3' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Girona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
87' The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.
86' Thomas Lemar (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Viktor Tsygankov.
86' Michel has decided to make a change. Abel Ruiz (Girona) replaces Fran Beltran.
85' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch so that Ante Budimir can be given a rest.
83' Ruben Garcia goes off the pitch and Abel Bretones (Osasuna) comes on.
83' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Iker Munoz and he is replaced by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).

80' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Kike Barja and planted his close-range header into the bottom right corner. Paulo Gazzaniga was helpless.
79' The attendance for today's match is 20975.

78' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Paulo Gazzaniga!
75' Michel prepares a substitution. Arnau Martinez is replaced by Alex Moreno (Girona).
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Vladyslav Vanat walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.

72' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) unleashes a promising shot towards the roof of the net after his wonderful solo run, but Paulo Gazzaniga thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Paulo Gazzaniga.
69' It will be a substitution. Kike Barja (Osasuna) is ready to enter the pitch as Aimar Oroz walks off.
68' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) picks up an injury.
65' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
63' The percentage of ball possession is – 55:45.
60' Substitution. Joel Roca will be replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Girona).
60' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
59' Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to Javi Galan (Osasuna) for his blatant foul. A free kick to Girona.
58' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
56' Close! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
55' Osasuna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
53' Joel Roca (Girona) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
52' Girona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
49' Joel Roca (Girona) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
47' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Jose Guzman blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45' The match has reached half-time.
44' Arnau Martinez (Girona) commits a rough foul. Jose Guzman stops the game and makes a call.
43' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
42' Fran Beltran (Girona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a throw-in.
39' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
38' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Girona.
35' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
34' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
34' The referee points to the corner flag and Osasuna will take a corner.
31' Jose Guzman has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alejandro Catena (Osasuna).
29' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
28' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' Osasuna try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
25' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
24' The Osasuna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
22' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Hugo Rincon (Girona) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Osasuna have a free kick.

19' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Ante Budimir (Osasuna) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
19' Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

18' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the bottom right corner, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save. The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
16' The Osasuna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
13' Osasuna take a short corner kick.

12' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper. Good work from Osasuna as they win a corner.
10' Javi Galan (Osasuna) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
9' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Girona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Javi Galan (Osasuna) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
1' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Osasuna have a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
